_comment: Stands in for the Google Drive files.list response when FIXTURE_DATA is set.
Shape mirrors the `fields` gallery.js asks for, so the real parsing, ordering,
ratio and caption-fallback code all still run against it.
The eleven ratios match the live folder, so the packer lays these out as the
same 3+2+3+3 rows the production page uses. `imageMediaMetadata` is the STORED
orientation: 04 carries rotation:1 to exercise the axis swap, so its metadata
reads 601x800 while the file on disk is the displayed 800x601.
10 deliberately has no description: that is the caption falling back to the
cleaned filename, and the baseline should show what that looks like.
